For each question, choose the correct answer.
Spending time outside
Many of us spend more time indoors than we do outside. But did you know that being inside too much can have a negative (21).................. on health? There have been a number of scientific studies which have (22).................. that being outside is good for us, even if it is just for a short (23).................. of time. One of the issues with being inside a lot is that we often sit watching a screen, like a TV or a laptop. Over time, this can damage our eyes. When we walk around in a natural environment like a forest, however, we (24).................. looking at things near and others which are some (25).................. away. This exercises our eye muscles, helping them stay healthy. What's more, scientists claim that looking at green plants can make us feel more creative, as well as (26).................. us the chance to switch off from our busy lives.

[--- Table Start ---]
| 21 | A problem | B effect | C condition | D conclusion |
| 22 | A approved | B sorted | C persuaded | D confirmed |
| 23 | A period | B age | C total | D level |
| 24 | A hold | B remain | C stay | D keep |
| 25 | A distance | B length | C amount | D range |
| 26 | A offer | B give | C provide | D deliver |
[--- Table End ---]

questions.explanation:
B. effect
“have a negative effect on health” 为固定搭配，意为 “对健康有负面影响”，“effect” 表示 “影响”，符合语境。
A. problem（问题）、C. condition（条件）、D. conclusion（结论）均不与 “have...on” 构成 “影响” 的含义。
拓展：“have a positive/negative effect on sth.” 为常用结构，如 “Exercise has a positive effect on mood.”（锻炼对情绪有积极影响）。

D. confirmed
“studies which have confirmed that...” 表示 “研究已证实……”，“confirmed” 意为 “证实”，符合科学研究的严谨性。
A. approved（批准）、B. sorted（分类）、C. persuaded（说服）均不与 “研究结论” 搭配。
拓展：“confirm” 后可接名词或从句，如 “confirm the results”（确认结果）、“confirm that the theory is correct”（证实理论正确）。

A. period
“a short period of time” 为固定短语，意为 “短时间”，“period” 表示 “一段时间”，符合语义。
B. age（年龄）、C. total（总数）、D. level（水平）均不与 “时间” 搭配。
拓展：“period” 可搭配 “long/short”，如 “a long period of study”（长时间的学习）。

D. keep
“keep looking at things” 表示 “持续观察事物”，“keep doing” 为固定结构，意为 “持续做某事”。
A. hold（持有）、B. remain（保持）、C. stay（停留）均不接动名词，语法错误。
拓展：“keep” 后接动名词强调 “动作的延续性”，如 “keep exercising”（坚持锻炼）。

A. distance
“some distance away” 为固定表达，意为 “一段距离之外”，“distance” 表示 “距离”，与 “near” 形成对比。
B. length（长度）、C. amount（数量）、D. range（范围）均不与 “away” 搭配表示 “距离”。
拓展：“at a distance”（在远处）、“in the distance”（在远方）为常见搭配。

C. provide
“provide us the chance” 表示 “为我们提供机会”，“provide sb. with sth.” 或 “provide sth. for sb.” 为固定用法。
A. offer（提供）需接 “to”，即 “offer sth. to sb.”；B. give（给）后接双宾语 “give sb. sth.”，但 “give the chance to switch off” 更常用；D. deliver（传递）与 “机会” 搭配不当。
拓展：“provide” 侧重 “供给所需之物”，如 “provide information”（提供信息）、“provide support”（提供支持）。
